node.label: Locomotive Lockout #367
node.description: This is an Instrumental Panel with two Push buttons and a 7-Segment display

node.label: Toggle DVMD
node.description: Driver Vigilance Monitoring Device and L168 Locomotive Anti-roll System

node.label: Toggle Block of USC
node.description: The USC block is a control unit for unauthorized shutdown of the EPV

node.label: X Brake Request
node.description: X = 1 - Emergency, 2 - Service. For Pneumatic Brake Microcontroller

object.script:
timerUSC, timerDVMD, timerL168, timerSpeedLimit, timerNoPlayer, timerPlayerSleep, timerSpeedDif = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 reversableHandle, tractionPos = 0, 0
function onTick() propertyDVMD = property.getNumber("DVMD") propertyTDVCS = property.getNumber("TDVCS") propertyUSC = property.getNumber("Block of USC") propertyABCS = property.getNumber("ABCS") -- speedLimit = property.getNumber("DVMD: Speed Limit (m/s)") timeCheckDVMD = property.getNumber("DVMD: Periodic check timer (s)") timeToSleepCheck = property.getNumber("TDVCS: Timer for checking wakefulness (s)")
prBL = input.getNumber(3) prBC = input.getNumber(5) dirSpeed = input.getNumber(6) seatAxisX = input.getNumber(7) seatAxisY = input.getNumber(8) playerCount = input.getNumber(9)
toggleDVMD = input.getBool(1) toggleTDVCS = input.getBool(2) toggleUSC = input.getBool(3) toggleABCS = input.getBool(4) VH = input.getBool(5) VHU = input.getBool(6) toggleEPV = input.getBool(7) machinistSeatOccupied = input.getBool(8)
-- USC if propertyUSC == 1 and toggleUSC then if dirSpeed > 2.75 and prBC < 0.7 and toggleEPV == false then timerUSC = timerUSC + 1 buzzerEPV_USC = true
if timerUSC >= 720 then serviceBrake_USC = true triggeredUSC = true buzzerEPV_USC = false end elseif toggleEPV == true and not triggeredUSC then buzzerEPV_USC = false timerUSC = 0 serviceBrake_USC = false end
if dirSpeed < 0.5 and toggleEPV then triggeredUSC = false buzzerEPV_USC = false timerUSC = 0 serviceBrake_USC = false end end
-- L168 if (propertyDVMD == 3 or propertyDVMD == 4) and toggleDVMD then if dirSpeed > 2.75 and reversableHandle == 0 and tractionPos == 0 and prBC < 0.7 then timerL168 = timerL168 + 1 buzzerEPV_L168 = true
if timerL168 >= 720 then serviceBrake_L168 = true buzzerEPV_L168 = false triggeredL168 = true end elseif (VH or VHU) and not triggeredL168 then buzzerEPV_L168 = false timerL168 = 0 serviceBrake_L168 = false end
if dirSpeed < 0.5 and (VH or VHU) then triggeredL168 = false buzzerEPV_L168 = false timerL168 = 0 serviceBrake_L168 = false end end
-- DVMD if propertyDVMD ~= 0 and toggleDVMD then timerDVMD = timerDVMD + 1
if timerDVMD >= (timeCheckDVMD * 60) then if propertyDVMD == 2 or propertyDVMD == 4 then PAL_DVMD = true end
if timerDVMD >= ((timeCheckDVMD * 60) + 420) then buzzerEPV_DVMD = true
if timerDVMD >= ((timeCheckDVMD * 60) + 840) then triggeredDVMD = true emergencyBrake_DVMD = true end end end
if (VH or VHU) and not triggeredDVMD then PAL_DVMD = false buzzerEPV_DVMD = false timerDVMD = 0 emergencyBrake_DVMD = false end
if (VH or VHU) and triggeredDVMD and dirSpeed < 1 then PAL_DVMD = false buzzerEPV_DVMD = false timerDVMD = 0 emergencyBrake_DVMD = false end
if dirSpeed > speedLimit then timerSpeedLimit = timerSpeedLimit + 1 buzzerEPV_SpeedLimit = true
if timerSpeedLimit >= 420 then triggeredSpeedLimit = true emergencyBrake_SpeedLimit = true end else if dirSpeed < speedLimit and not triggeredSpeedLimit then timerSpeedLimit = 0 emergencyBrake_SpeedLimit = false buzzerEPV_SpeedLimit = false end end
if dirSpeed < speedLimit then buzzerEPV_SpeedLimit = false if dirSpeed < 1 and triggeredSpeedLimit then timerSpeedLimit = 0 emergencyBrake_SpeedLimit = false end end end
-- TDVCS if propertyTDVCS ~= 0 and toggleTDVCS then if playerCount == 0 and dirSpeed > 1 then timerNoPlayer = timerNoPlayer + 1
if timerNoPlayer >= 420 then emergencyBrake_TDVCS = true end elseif playerCount >= 1 then timerNoPlayer = 0 emergencyBrake_TDVCS = false end
if (seatAxisX == 0 and seatAxisY == 0) and machinistSeatOccupied then timerPlayerSleep = timerPlayerSleep + 1
if timerPlayerSleep > (timeToSleepCheck * 60) then buzzerEPV_TDVCS = true if propertyTDVCS == 2 then PAL_TDVCS = true end
if timerPlayerSleep > ((timeToSleepCheck * 60) + 420) then emergencyBrake_TDVCS = true triggeredPlayerSleep = true end end end
if VHU and not triggeredPlayerSleep then timerPlayerSleep = 0 buzzerEPV_TDVCS = false PAL_TDVCS = false emergencyBrake_TDVCS = false end
if dirSpeed < 1 and VHU and triggeredPlayerSleep then timerPlayerSleep = 0 buzzerEPV_TDVCS = false PAL_TDVCS = false emergencyBrake_TDVCS = false end end
-- ABCS if propertyABCS ~= 0 and toggleABCS then speedDif = speedLimit - dirSpeed if speedDif <= 4 then signal_ABCS = true else signal_ABCS = false end
if speedDif <= 1 then timerSpeedDif = timerSpeedDif + 1 serviceBrakeRequest_ABCS = true if timerSpeedDif >= 120 then serviceBrakeRequest_ABCS = false end end end
-- CONTROL serviceBrakeRequest = (serviceBrake_L168 or false) or (serviceBrake_USC or false) or (serviceBrakeRequest_ABCS or false)
emergencyBrakeRequest = (emergencyBrake_DVMD or false) or (emergencyBrake_TDVCS or false) or (emergencyBrake_SpeedLimit or false)
PAL = (PAL_DVMD or false) or (PAL_TDVCS or false)
buzzerEPV = (buzzerEPV_DVMD or false) or (buzzerEPV_L168 or false) or (buzzerEPV_SpeedLimit or false) or (buzzerEPV_TDVCS or false) or (buzzerEPV_USC or false)
output.setBool(1, emergencyBrakeRequest) output.setBool(2, serviceBrakeRequest) output.setBool(3, PAL) output.setBool(4, buzzerEPV) output.setBool(5, signal_ABCS) end
